build_DINOHead_classifier: build a DINOHead classifier with a 3-layer MLP and weight-normalized last layer for self-supervised learning
create_DINOHead_with_batchnorm: create a DINOHead with batch normalization enabled in the MLP layers for improved training stability
run_DINOHead_forward_pass: run a forward pass through DINOHead that normalizes MLP output and projects to output dimension
build_mlp_with_build_mlp: build an MLP with configurable layers, hidden dimensions, and optional batch normalization using _build_mlp
review_DINOHead_init_weights: review the DINOHead weight initialization that uses truncated normal distribution with std 0.02
